bloques.titulo: In addition to the main occupation, it has a secondary activity.
texto: It is often associated with stable activities and written registration. It is not the normal connector for two simultaneous short actions.
In addition to teaching at the university, it also translates specialized books.
In addition to running a company, it teaches music to community children.
